exposure: intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) / Obstetric cholestasis (OC)
cohort: The study included medical records of women with Obstetric Cholestasis (cases) and a control group (without OC) who delivered between January 2015 and January 2016 at a hospital in Patna.
finding: Women with Obstetric Cholestasis (OC) showed a significantly higher incidence of meconium staining in amniotic fluid and preterm premature rupture of membranes compared to controls, but no statistically significant difference was found in preterm delivery rate, pathological cardiotocography, low Apgar scores, IUGR, NICU admission, or perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate among women with Obstetric Cholestasis was very high at 93.3%.
